Apple has unveiled a trailer for Slow Horses Season 6, featuring some surprise returns

Apple TV+ is currently airing one of its most popular series, Ted Lasso. Another beloved show is also making a return soon.

Slow Horses Season 6 premieres with one episode on Wednesday, September 16, and then drops new episodes weekly until October 21.

If you want to watch the next season of Slow Horses completely unspoiled, stop reading here.

Apple released the trailer for Slow Horses Season 6 today, revealing two notable returning characters. One of them has not appeared since Season 1, when they were presumed dead.

As the trailer reveals, Season 6 appears to bring back several former "Slough House" members.

The biggest surprise is Olivia Cooke (House of the Dragon) appearing at the end of the trailer, reprising her role as Sidonie "Sid" Baker. The character has been presumed dead since Season 1.

The other major returning star is Hugo Weaving, who was the main villain in Season 4, and whom we already knew was significant to River Cartwright.

You can watch Slow Horses on Apple TV+.

What did you think of the Slow Horses trailer? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV+ costs $12.99 per month, or it can be bundled with Apple One.
